Overview.Name: Samanthula Krishna Kumari
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Tuesday and Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + sautéed vegetables
Option 2: Paneer cubes (120 g) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & sautéed vegetables
Meal_3 (Dinner - lighter): Option 2: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Follow vegetarian meals on Tuesday and Saturday.
Reduce sweets and bakery foods to support PCOS recovery and fat loss.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or chicken before eating rice.
Morning sunlight exposure can improve hormone balance, mood and sleep quality.
Regular yoga, hydration and fixed meal timing will help improve cravings and energy levels.
